title: Te Kaihanga o ngā Ārai
intro: I roto i ngā whenua whānui, i tīmata tētahi tangata whai mana i tētahi raupapa o ngā haerenga, ā, i whakawhiwhia ki a ia he mana nui me ngā rauemi. I tūtaki tēnei wairua ki ngā hapori kanorau, ā, i tūtaki ki ngā wero ahurei, i waiho he tohu pumau ki te hītori me te whakapono mā roto i ā rātou mahi me te whakaaro nui, me te whakaae tonu ki te pūtake pono o tō rātou kaha.
clues: I homai ki ahau te mana me ngā rawa mō ngā mea katoa, ā, i whai ahau i tētahi ara.
I haria ahau e taku haerenga ki te tōnga o te rā, ki te wāhi i kitea ai e au tētahi iwi.
I tūtaki ahau ki tētahi hapori kāore i te tino mārama ki te kōrero, e noho ana i waenganui i ngā maunga e rua.
I tonoa ahau kia hanga he ārai, ehara i te mea hei painga mōku ake, engari hei tiaki i ahau i tētahi mana whakangaro.
I kī atu ahau ko te kaha ki te hanga i tēnei taiepa nui i ahu mai i a Allah, ā, ka tū tonu tae noa ki te wā i whakaritea.
Ko tōku ingoa, e whakamaoritia ana ko 'Te Mea e Rua ngā Haona,' e tohu ana i tōku horapa puta noa i te ao, i ngā wā rerekē rānei e rua.

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
